title: What if the Moon were 10 times closer?
note: First live Short, reference style (docs/shorts/moon-reference-analysis.md): ONE continuous 10 s vertical shot, 2 chained 5 s beats, a real-looking shore plate with ambient waves, and the Moon as a separate layer composited in code. Validated by studio/tests/test_moon_plan.py. Runbook: docs/runbooks/first-live-short.md.

video.title: What if the Moon were 10 times closer?
video.summary: A 10-second vertical Short: one continuous locked-off shot of a night shore with waves rolling in while a huge Moon slowly rises and grows above the sea.
mustInclude: huge Moon slowly growing and rising
top caption: What if the Moon were 10x closer?
video.rationale: Owner-chosen idea in the style of his five reference Shorts: one shot, one huge object, real ambient motion, tiny caption.

generation.style: realistic photographic night, natural motion blur, locked-off camera, no text, no people

moon.note: Primary (b): the plate prompts show an EMPTY sky; the Moon is a separate picture composited by tools/film4k/moon_layer.py over the whole 10 s timeline (continuous across the beat seam).

layer.asset: one Moon picture on black (lit disc, real craters), luma-keyed to alpha; source decided by the owner (public-domain photo or one FLUX picture)

fallback.note: (a) If the layer looks fake: let the model draw the large Moon inside the plate, same camera presets, no composite step.

script.text: Imagine the Moon ten times closer, rising huge over a calm sea.
Tides would climb far higher, flooding coasts twice a day beneath one enormous Moon.
